title: Armor: Blocker
description: Replicate the blocker (collision/armor understructure) from Blender-Procedural-Human in Ixdar DSL. Source: procedural_human/geo_node_groups/armor/blocker/ (subdirectory with main.py, chest.py, collar/). Key techniques: ico_sphere, curve_circle, mesh-to-sdf-grid, align-rotation, quilting/stitching patterns. Most technically demanding — may require new SDF/volume nodes in Ixdar.
definition-of-done: 1. blocker.dsl compiles without errors. 2. Mesh comparison gate passes. 3. Visual comparison shows recognizable silhouette match.
testing-plan: 1. Export Blender reference OBJ. 2. Run validate-dsl to export generated OBJ. 3. Run mesh_distance() comparison. 4. Visual inspection.
